correctness.rationale: Proof step 1 obtains rank-two complementary orthogonal projection with six equal diagonal entries; the induced six complex unit roots have first two power sums zero, forcing two equilateral triples. Step 2 uses Cauchy brightness formula and independently derived absolute-product spherical integral to compute exact variance. Step 3 verifies t1²+t2²+t0²=1, strict growth of largest sorted square and largest-two sum, and strict convexity of H(sqrt(s)), proving global monotonicity by strict Karamata. Endpoints, uniqueness and normalization checked analytically; the provided independent numerical program passed 5 spherical quadratures, algebraic moment tests and endpoint constants. Numerical tests alone never establish continuity conclusions.

value.rationale: The six-node equal-weight 2-design is the smallest naturally flexible nondegenerate class of equal-area facet-normal polyhedra in R3. Its second moments force all expected shadow areas to equal π while leaving nonzero dispersion; the exact sharp variance interval, strict twist ordering, and equalities isolate a non-Platonic minimizer and a cube maximizer. These quantify a motivated geometric-probability gap left by fixed tensor moments and by generic design brightness bounds, not arbitrary parameter slicing.
